summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests tebentafusp given together with yttrium-90 radioembolization in people with metastatic uveal melanoma that has spread mainly to the liver. Participants first receive yttrium-90 radioembolization, followed by a 14 to 28 day recovery period, and then tebentafusp once a week in 28-day cycles for up to 24 months or 24 cycles. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa tebentafusp combinado con radioembolización de itrio-90 en personas con melanoma uveal metastásico que se ha diseminado principalmente al hígado. Los participantes reciben primero la radioembolización de itrio-90, seguida de un período de recuperación de 14 a 28 días, y luego tebentafusp una vez por semana en ciclos de 28 días, por hasta 24 meses o 24 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Metastatic uveal melanoma mainly in the liver, confirmed by pathology review.
Bilirubin under 2 mg/dl; AST and ALT under 5 times the upper limit of normal.
Angiogram shows radioembolization is feasible and safe to perform.
HLA-A*02:01 positive, age 18 or older, and ECOG performance status 0-1.
Measurable or non-measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 and ability to give written consent.
not_for: Liver enzyme, bilirubin, or blood count results outside the listed limits.
Significant heart disease, uncontrolled blood pressure, uncontrolled atrial fibrillation, or prolonged QT interval.
Symptomatic or untreated brain or CNS metastases, or active hepatitis B or C.
Prior radioembolization or other liver-directed therapy to the same site.
